prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='DWT_catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: CWT_rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while DWT_catboost leads in seasonality capture (0.883). CWT_catboost wins overall RMSE (2693) with strong early-horizon performance. High model disagreement (RMSE spread 5.75), concept drift, and split trend/seasonality champions suggest STL-hierarchical stacking with mixed weighting to exploit complementary strengths.
